text:
oliver k: starting deploy for feature flag `priority-routing-v3`. target rollout: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over ~40m with automatic guardrails. runbook pinned: https://confluence.redwood/KB/priority-routing-v3
maya t: ack. main checks: p95 latency, error-rate, and model-quality delta on eval-suite C. rollback thresholds: p95 +20% or error-rate >1.3x for 4m.
anya p: release notes draft ready, will add note about config pinning if we need fallback. release link: https://release.redwood/notes/2026-03-priorityrouting
deploy-bot: deploy job 4892 queued by oliver k. image: rwd/prior-route:v3-20260323. dry-run passed.
oliver k: window is 23:30-01:00 UTC. infra oncall: @oncall please monitor infra-level alerts.
oncall: standing by, will escalate if autopause triggers.
deploy-bot: applying ff priority-routing-v3 -> 1% (cohort sampling).
maya t: seeing baseline sensors, p95 flat, p99 small spike +5ms. starting eval-suite C run for the 1% cohort.
infra-bot: autoscaler increased router replica by 1 due to transient CPU. no errors logged.
anya p: adding config pin snippet to runbook: `rwdctl config pin routing.priority v2-fallback` in case of emergency.
oliver k: good. waiting 8m then move to 5% if green.
deploy-bot: feature flag priority-routing-v3 -> 5% applied. cohorts updated.
maya t: eval C partial results: quality neutral. telemetry: p95 +6%, errors stable.
infra-bot: noticed one pod with steady 50% more memory consumption (router-2). collecting logs.
oncall: investigating now.
infra-bot: logs show increased KV cache churn on router-2, gc spikes.
maya t: that might explain mem increase. can we lower cache footprint for v3?
oliver k: patch ready to flip cache-policy for new route: image rwd/prior-route:v3-20260323b. plan: canary the single-pod update and keep flag percentages.
deploy-bot: initiating canary image swap on router-2 to v3-20260323b.
anya p: updated release notes: "hotfix image v3b applied to reduce cache pressure".
infra-bot: patched pod stable after canary. mem usage down to normal.
maya t: eval-suite C rerun on canary looks fine. no quality regressions.
oliver k: proceed to 20% ramp in 15m unless issues. set autopause: if error-rate >25% or p95 delta >25% for 3m.
deploy-bot: autopause rule attached to job 4892.
anya p: adding rollback commands to the top of the runbook: `rwdctl ff set priority-routing-v3 0 --actor oliver_k` and `rwdctl config unpin routing.priority`
maya t: during the 10%->20% ramp we should run eval D (long-context heavy). flag that for product.
infra-bot: scaling looks healthy so far. small p99 jitter for long-context flows at 12% traffic.
oliver k: start ramp to 20% now.
deploy-bot: feature flag priority-routing-v3 -> 20% applied. cohorts updated.
maya t: eval D interim: 0.9% precision regression on long-context slice. p95 long-context +22% (above our declared threshold).
oncall: autopause triggered by deploy-bot. pausing rollout at 20%.
deploy-bot: autopause: job 4892 paused due to p95 delta threshold breach. feature flag remains at 20%.
anya p: marking rollout status: PAUSED. adding note to release page and pinging product.
oliver k: do not rollback immediately. set the flag to hold and run a targeted canary drain to reduce long-context routing for a small cohort while we investigate.
maya t: agree. run targeted cohort adjustment: reduce long-context routing weight by 50% for cohorts above 10%. command: `rwdctl ff tweak priority-routing-v3 --cohort-threshold 10 --long-context-weight 0.5`
deploy-bot: applied cohort tweak. downstream traffic now reduced for long-context by 50% on affected cohorts.
infra-bot: p95 long-context trending down slowly.
maya t: re-running eval D on the adjusted traffic, results improving but not fully recovered. quality delta now 0.4%.
anya p: drafting a brief "pause and investigate" note for engineers and PMs. will include rollback playbook and timeline.
oliver k: excellent. schedule: keep paused overnight, hit the rollback playbook early if metrics worsen. will regroup in the morning with product. cc @oncall
oncall: acknowledged. will escalate if autopause conditions re-trigger. :thumbsup:
release-bot: rollout job 4892 status updated: PAUSED @20% due to perf/quality. link: https://release.redwood/status/4892
maya t: opened ticket #9876 with eval outputs, telemetry dumps, and proposed mitigation steps. tagging product and SRE.
anya p: updated release notes to include paused status and hotfix image note.
oliver k: thanks all. follow-ups: 1) add extra long-context evals to morning CI 2) consider reverting long-context portion via targeted cohort reduction 3) prepare controlled rollback snippet if needed.
maya t: will own extra evals tomorrow.
anya p: will send an update to product and stakeholders in the AM.
infra-bot: logs archived to s3://redwood-logs/4892/ for postmortem.
oliver k: will write short incident note if we don't resume. good job team. :pray:
